newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai arrests district police head for bribery.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai arrests district police head for bribery.

text.p: A district police chief in Shanghai has been arrested and charged with accepting bribes, a senior Public Security official said on Tuesday.
The official said the case, which he said came to light last year, was now being handled by the courts. He declined to give any other details.
Hong Kong's mass-circulation Apple Daily reported this week that Kong Jifeng was arrested on Saturday for taking bribes of more than 10,000 yuan ($1,205).
Officials from the Xuhui District of central Shanghai and the Public Security Bureau's foreign affairs office declined to comment.
The Public Security official denied other Hong Kong media reports that the former head of the Shanghai Public Security Bureau, Zhu Daren, had retired or stepped down from all public positions.

Zhu, who served as the head of the bureau from 1991 until earlier this year, has been promoted to a position in the city's Politics and Legal Committee, which helps supervise the Public Security Bureau, the official said.
Liu Yungeng has taken over as director of the bureau, he said. The official declined to give reasons for the change.
